title: IRGC Spokesperson Brigadier General Mohebbi:
text:
IRGC Spokesperson Brigadier General Mohebbi: "

"🔹 The reopening of the Strait of Hormuz is subject to the specific mechanisms and conditions of the Islamic Republic of Iran and is entirely unrelated to the negotiations between Iran and Oman."

"🔹 For us, the Strait of Hormuz is not merely an economic waterway, but rather a key component of our geopolitical and strategic power."

"🔹 The reopening of the Strait of Hormuz depends on the United States fully accepting Iran's conditions and ceasing its interference in regional negotiations; whenever the US accepts Iran's conditions, the Strait of Hormuz will undoubtedly be reopened."
